capabilities: Count down days to anniversaries and birthdays, showing ages and years together
Track weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly recurring events
Convert between Chinese lunar and solar dates, including leap-month birthdays
Display Chinese zodiac animals and zodiac signs for birthdays
Store all entries in one hand-editable Markdown note with conflict protection
extras: README is mostly in Chinese with a full English section; the data file's headings and lunar markers must literally be Chinese (纪念日/生日/周期事件, 农历), though entry names can be in any language. The plugin makes no network requests and works fully offline. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for counting down to personal dates like birthdays and anniversaries, especially recurring ones on the Chinese lunar calendar.

relations.evidence: You can also install BRAT and add the repository

summary: Countdown tracker for anniversaries, birthdays, and recurring events with Chinese lunar date support, stored in one plain Markdown note.
